full_details: The stoop of a king come home from sea was tried between cues and stopped. On the way back the post had the Rose's bill, A Knack to Know an Honest Man. You did not go to the Rose. The afternoon was The Comedy of Errors, and you were in it. The book of the comedy was still at Field's. No new line went into Egeon.
one_sentence: You walked an old duke's forty lines until you could say there to a hedge, and you read the Rose's bill on a post.
title: Said there to a hedge
